Texas Garter Snake I caught today, cute little guy.

My son and I caught two of these guys a few months ago. I grew up catching little grey garters all the time, never seen one as colorful as these. The middle stripe on yours looks red though, while ours is gold. I'll upload a pic one I get to my computer.

Of course we kept them, but unfortunately the smaller one died due to my own negligence... I left a fish in the bowl overnight thinking it would be fine and I found him the next morning with a piece of the substrate stuck wedging his jaw open. Btw, don't do that.

Edit : a pic http://veuwer.com/2md7.png

That is a pretty big color difference, where about did you catch them? I caught this guy in south Austin. I was thinking about keeping him but when I caught him he unfortunately regurgitated a little frog and I thought it would be hard to get him to feed in captivity. Was it hard for you guys to get them to feed or did they just go for it?

We caught them at a park in north Arlington/Grand Prairie, just a few yards away from the Trinity River. I initially bought some pinkies to feed them but they weren't interested at all, so I got some minnows and the small one didn't waste any time gobbling up about 10 of them right away. It shocked me that such a small snake could eat so many in one sitting. The larger one (female I think) wouldn't eat the minnows either for the first week or so, but I think that was because she was in the process of molting. Once she shed her skin she started eating like the smaller guy, but she's still a bit shy when she sees me watching. I got a few videos of them eating too, I'll upload those if you'd like.

I've read that they need a somewhat varied diet unless you can get them to eat mice/pinkies. I got some calcium powder at petsmart and sprinkle a little of that in the water bowl to supplement. Other than that, idk what else they will eat. I haven't tried it yet but I might float a pinky or two in the bowl with the minnows and see if I can get her to accidentally eat one that way.

Cool, good to hear, I'm going to keep looking in the area and if I catch another I might give it a go. I don't know why but garter and ribbon snakes fascinate me much more then most common pet snakes and I would love to start keep some. Have you tried scenting the pinkies with the minnows? Or have you tried earthworms? Though they are low on calcium I've heard if you dip the opposite end of the worm in calcium powder they will take it. I've also read they will eat slugs which are very rich in calcium.

I've heard that you can scent the pinkies to make them more enticing, but how would you go about doing that? Just rub a fish on it? lol.. I was going to try some red wigglers before I tried the minnows, but luckily I read that wigglers can be toxic to snakes before I actually fed them to them. I haven't tried night-crawlers yet... I have no idea where to get slugs.
